datasets.name: Sentinel-2 Level-1C orthorectified, spatially registered, tiled top-of-atmosphere (TOA) reflectance image time series
datasets.verbatim: We use Sentinel-2 Level-1C orthorectified, spatially registered, tiled top-of-atmosphere (TOA) reflectance image time series from 2016 until 2021 (ESA, 2021).

datasets.name: ESA Climate Change Initiative Land Cover product
datasets.verbatim: We employ the ESA Climate Change Initiative Land Cover product (ESA, 2016) to assess the influence of land cover on the detectability of GH events in our methodology.

datasets.name: Copernicus GLO30m digital elevation model
datasets.verbatim: Then, radiometric, spectral, spatial and topographic features are extracted on the input imagery and the Copernicus GLO30m digital elevation model (DEM)

methods.name: Semi-supervised multi-temporal methodology for GH event detection
methods.summary: The methodology uses the peak of the cumulative difference to the mean for spectral indices derived from Sentinel-2 time series to identify impacted pixels and timing. These results are then used as training samples in an OBIA-ML based detection tool (ALADIM) to improve spatial detection accuracy.
methods.verbatim: We present a new semi-supervised methodology that allows for the detection of both location and timing of GH event occurrence with optical time series, while minimizing manual user interventions.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code used for the methodology lacks a repository or persistent link.
